risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and quantitatively supported, describing revenue recognition, collectability, contract-loss estimates, operating metrics, and year-over-year performance. Key risks include estimation uncertainty in fixed-price contracts and receivables, potentially declining activity in major investigations and technology development, and unlimited contractual indemnification exposure, although management characterizes insured exposure as minimal.
